incumbent.description: Repository intelligence enrichment pipeline split across six one-request-at-a-time shard workers.

oracle_contract: A readiness attributes summed gateway occupancy to all six captured shard owners.
With A healthy, B records tenant-level concurrency admission failures and cannot reach its four-request cohort.
Every original A shard and the supervisor remain alive and advancing after B.
The unchanged B command succeeds after aggregate A occupancy is released.
